title: Add Decimal Strings
description: Given two non-negative decimal integers represented as strings, return their sum as a decimal string. Neither input has leading zeroes unless it is exactly `"0"`. Do not convert the entire input to a built-in integer type. Input: `num1` and `num2`. Output: their exact sum as a string.
constraints: Each input contains only decimal digits
No leading zeroes unless the input is "0"
hints: Keep track of the smallest state needed to continue matching or comparing characters.
Test empty, one-character, repeated-character, and boundary inputs.
